chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: Slipping out to the roof garden and ragtime
summary: He played at an Atlanta roof garden; the music was ragtime.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets

blocks.x: During that two-year period you said that you used to slip out sometimes and play.
At the roof garden. What was the name of the band?
No, that was in Cincinnati. I'm still trying to finish up Atlanta.
Well, he would go up there and play with, you know, whoever was playing on the roof garden. There was a band up there.
I don't remember, because we used to, when we were young, we used to slip off and go up there to the dances...
What kind of music were they playing at the time?
They called it ragtime before Dixieland?
Do you remember any kind of music, the names of any of the songs that were popular when you were in Morris Brown?
